about: clicky eval brain: 20 scripted pages. `expect.point` lists acceptable targets (role + case-insensitive name substring; `region` = CSS-px box for things without an element id); `optional` accepts a reply without pointing; `none` expects no pointing. `say` lists words of which at least one must be spoken. Pages are captured by extension/tests/e2e/eval-capture.spec.ts through the real snapshot + screenshot path.
